about: Burnaby sits between Vancouver and the eastern suburbs of Metro Vancouver, from Burrard Inlet south to the Fraser River. It is a densely developed city of high-rises at Metrotown, two SkyTrain lines, and large parks such as Burnaby Mountain. Simon Fraser University occupies the mountain’s peak. About 250,000 people live in Burnaby.
